entries.mechanism: Serving costs dominate the lab's spending, and purpose-built silicon serves cheaper, so custom parts take the largest line.
entries.sensitivity: Most sensitive to delivery schedules on the custom parts.
entries.statement: At one leading model lab the biggest single hardware obligation is now custom-chip equipment rather than merchant accelerators.
entries.title: Custom silicon becomes a lab's largest hardware bill

entries.falsifiableTrigger: Reported AI revenue at the largest buyers doubles within 4 quarters, or a forecaster cuts the required revenue figure by half.
entries.mechanism: Capacity is committed against revenue that does not yet exist, so the gap has to close or the spending must stop.
entries.sensitivity: Most sensitive to how fast paid artificial-intelligence services grow.
entries.statement: Independent forecasters now put the annual revenue needed to justify committed AI capacity several times above what the industry earns today.
entries.title: The revenue needed to pay for committed capacity is far away

entries.falsifiableTrigger: Reported blocked or delayed project value falls below $20 billion in a quarter, or the delayed permits are granted within 2 quarters.
entries.mechanism: Local permitting and water or power objections stop projects before construction, which removes capacity rather than delaying it.
entries.sensitivity: Most sensitive to local political attitudes toward large sites.
entries.statement: Local opposition and resource limits are stopping large data-centre projects before they start, not just slowing them down.
entries.title: Local objections now block sites outright

entries.falsifiableTrigger: No insurer writes such a policy within 4 quarters, or a chip-backed loan is repriced within 2 quarters.
entries.mechanism: Lenders will not take resale risk on accelerators, so someone else has to carry it for the loans to happen.
entries.sensitivity: Most sensitive to observed resale values for used accelerators.
entries.statement: The leading accelerator vendor is exploring insurance that would cover lenders when pledged chips cannot be resold for enough to repay their loans.
entries.title: Insurers are being drawn into chip lending

entries.falsifiableTrigger: No such vehicle closes with named investors and disclosed terms within 2 quarters, or the plan is withdrawn within 1 quarter.
entries.mechanism: Selling and leasing back the hardware moves the purchase cost off the buyer's balance sheet while it keeps using the machines.
entries.sensitivity: Most sensitive to how outside investors value used accelerators at the end of the lease.
entries.statement: A large cloud buyer plans to sell about $8 billion of accelerators into a separate company and lease the same hardware back, with outside investors taking debt and up to a tenth of the equity.
entries.title: Buyers move chips off their own books into leasing vehicles

entries.falsifiableTrigger: A chip-secured loan to a small cloud operator closes with no vendor collateral within 2 quarters, or the required collateral share falls below 10 percent.
entries.mechanism: Lenders doubt the resale value of used accelerators, so they demand the vendor absorb the first loss before they will fund.
entries.sensitivity: Most sensitive to the useful life lenders assign to accelerators.
entries.statement: Banks and private credit firms will no longer write chip-secured loans to small cloud operators unless the accelerator vendor posts collateral of up to a quarter of the loan.
entries.title: Lenders make the chip vendor share the downside

entries.falsifiableTrigger: The $42 billion senior tranche fails to syndicate within 2 quarters, or the junior tranche is cut below $9 billion.
entries.mechanism: Dedicated debt lets custom programmes scale without waiting for the buyer's own cash, which speeds their challenge to merchant parts.
entries.sensitivity: Most sensitive to bank appetite for lending against a single lab's contracts.
entries.statement: A bank group is assembling about $60 billion of new financing, split into a $42 billion senior tranche and an $18 billion junior tranche, purely to fund custom accelerator capacity for one model lab and others.
entries.title: Custom chip programmes arrive with their own bank syndicates
